prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Carbon (C) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform
Outfit: a modern toga mini dress — one-shoulder draped jersey in a short wrap, a gold cuff on the upper arm and strappy sandals — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too — only her eyes turn toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a stick of charcoal and a small raw diamond in one hand at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: legs crossed at the knee.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — two faces of one element: black soot and clear diamond; hexagonal lattices (graphite, graphene) as patterns, pencil-graphite grey, carbon-fibre weave; it bonds with everything and is the frame of all life — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: 원본 PNG는 저장소에 올리지 않음. 생성 후 재생성하지 않음.

observations: 성인 여성 한 명이 주인공이며 일본 유화 애니 계열의 채색과 선을 유지
팔과 손이 신체에서 자연스럽게 이어짐; 보이는 손가락과 가려진 부분을 구분해 검수
참조한 해당 세계 원본과 머리 형태·머리색·눈색 및 얼굴 인상을 대조
세계컷의 갑옷과 모자를 일상 의상으로 바꿈
프롬프트가 지정한 크롭에 따라 화면 밖 손·다리 존재; 보이지 않는 손가락 수는 단정하지 않음
옆모습 요청보다 몸이 카메라 쪽으로 더 돌아가 있음.
qa.cause: 생성 결과에서 계획한 자세·방향·크롭 또는 의상 길이 일부가 달라짐. 원본 보존 후 그대로 등록.

acceptance: 사용자 선택 3,3,4 및 완료 후 커밋·main 일반 반영 승인. 생성 후 노출 사유 재생성 금지.
